Interface SaveableConfigProvider<T>

All Superinterfaces:
ConfigProvider<T>, Provider<T>, jakarta.inject.Provider<T>, javax.inject.Provider<T>
All Known Subinterfaces:
WrappingConfigProvider<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
CachingConfigProvider, DelegatingConfigProvider, FileBasedConfigProvider, FileWatchingConfigProvider
public interface SaveableConfigProvider<T> extends ConfigProvider<T>
A ConfigProvider that supports saving to the same source it reads from. This interface may be implemented directly by providers that support saving, or by wrappers that delegate to a saveable provider.

If the underlying source does not support saving, the save(T) method should return a failed Result containing a UnsupportedOperationException.

    • save

      default Result<DataTree> save(T instance)
      Saves the given config instance back to the file. This can be used to save default values for missing fields. By default, this only adds missing fields and does not override existing ones.
      Parameters:
      instance - the config instance to save
      Returns:
      a Result indicating success or failure, containing the exact DataTree that was written

    • save

      Result<DataTree> save(T instance, boolean overrideExisting)
      Saves the given config instance back to the file. This can be used to save default values for missing fields.
      Parameters:
      instance - the config instance to save
      overrideExisting - if true, overwrites the entire file; if false, only adds missing fields
      Returns:
      a Result indicating success or failure, containing the exact DataTree that was written
